items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: Louis Primer, and Leon Primer, they changed around... Louis Primer, not Leon, not the one running the 500, Louis Primer.

ctx.x: Da, da, da, da, da, da, da, da.

Uh, same thing was played that time. It was punch played in Chicago. Yeah. Uh, Panama didn't change. Some of the white Dixieland bands changed it. No, they didn't change. Some of the, some of the, uh, some of the white bands changed around, made a different arrangement. Uh, like, say, for instance, Sharky's band. Uh, the band that were coming up there behind these fellas. Uh, Louis Primer, and Leon Primer, they changed around, you know. A lot of things they couldn't memorize, they had, uh, they wrote it down.…
Yes, I heard that. I know that we struggled living down the road.
